messages:
sarah.k: Heads-up — last night's SEV with CloudGear (marketplace listing + hw integration) exposed some gaps in how we bring partners into war rooms. We had duplicate bridges and missed the partner-oncall for 12 minutes. Not great.
raj: Yikes. Do we have a post-incident timeline?
emily_p: Quick timeline in the incident doc, but main problem was: 1) no shared channel pre-created, 2) partner contact in their portal didn't map to live oncall, 3) our runbook assumed partner Slack access.
mike_ops: Agree. Proposed fix: an "ops-lane" pattern for partner escalations. Lightweight shared channel + ephemeral war-room naming + auto-invite flow.
partner_oncall: +1 from partner side. If you create the war-room channel we prefer a naming convention so our SREs can detect it automatically.
marketplace_pm: Can we make it deterministic? Suggest: `#warroom-partner-<partner-short>-<sev-level>-<date>` Example: `#warroom-partner-cloudgear-s1-20240203`
raj: Love deterministic names. Also add a single point of contact token in the channel topic: `PartnerOncall: slack:@cloudgear-oncall | Phone: +1-555-0102`
sarah.k: Operational flow I'm proposing (short):
1) Incident detected -> rotation on-call pings `@partner-oncall` (if integrated) and runs `./scripts/warp create-warroom --partner cloudgear --sev s1`
2) Script creates `#warroom-partner-...`, posts the runbook link, and triggers the deploy-bot to create a temporary bridge link (meet URL)
3) Partner SREs auto-invited using the partner directory mapping; if mapping fails, fallback is call-tree in channel topic
4) Postmortem collects partner timeline via a pinned form in the channel

mike_ops: Example of the script output we can standardize (bot msg):
```
deploy-bot: Created #warroom-partner-cloudgear-s1-20240203
Pinned: Runbook - https://redwood-internal/ops/partner-sev-runbook
Invited: @raj, @mike_ops, @partner-oncall (cloudgear-oncall)
Bridge: https://meet.redwood/abc123
```
emily_p: We should also add an explicit fallback routing: if partner Slack integration isn't present, our page will escalate to Partner Success (ps-team) and start the phone bridge automatically after 5 min.
partner_oncall: Phone bridge fallback is good. Also please include a short "what we need from partner" checklist in the channel:
- quick confirmation of impacted customers
- known HW batches/firmware versions
- local logs (s3 link or paste)

raj: For automation we need two things from Partnerships team: 1) partner directory API endpoint with current oncall handles and 2) permission to auto-invite partner bot principals into ephemeral channels.
marketplace_pm: I'll scope the API and bring legal in for the invite permission. ETA: 2 weeks to spec, 6 weeks to delivery unless we prioritize.
sarah.k: Short-term mitigation: ops-runbook update + a checklist pinned in `#partnerships` and add a Slack shortcut to create war-rooms manually (no script). Can someone own the runbook edit?
mike_ops: I'll own the runbook update this week. I'll also add the channel naming template and the fallback escalation timeline (5m -> phone bridge -> exec ping).
emily_p: I'll draft the partner-side checklist and reach out to CloudGear to confirm they can accept auto-invites.
partner_oncall: We'll test accepting invites in a staging channel Tue morning. If no invite, we'll expect the phone bridge.
sarah.k: Great — action items: Mike -> runbook + shortcut; Emily -> partner checklist + outreach; Marketplace PM -> API spec; Raj -> quick script prototype for bridge creation. We'll reconvene Friday 10am PT to sign off. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: Weekly war-room drill every Tue 09:00 PT — next: 3/12/2024.
